## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Restore the inclusive approval check before merge: with the default `minimum=2`, a release with exactly two approvals is now blocked, which goes against the gate's own docstring. The regenerated catalog also has a top-level entry that is not a service, and it should be removed.

## Changes
This PR renames all 1,500 `legacy-service-NNNN` catalog entries to `production-service-NNNN`, moves their ports from 1xxxx to 2xxxx, and adds a `review_note` key. It also rewrites `healthy()` as `not failures` and changes the release gate's comparison from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` so exactly-minimum approvals pass — `approved(2)` with the default `minimum=2` now returns `False`, because `approvals > minimum` excludes the boundary. The module docstring at line 1 says "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." The tests at tests/test_release.py:12 and :16 check only 3 and 1, so neither catches this. — Every release that has exactly the required number of approvals is blocked, and no test flags the regression. — Fix: Revert to `approvals >= minimum` and add an `approved(2, minimum=2)` case to `test_approved_release`.

## Important
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the non-service `review_note` key from the catalog — The catalog now maps `"review_note"` to a string. Every other top-level value is an object with `port` and `enabled`. Any consumer that iterates the catalog and reads `entry["port"]` or `entry["enabled"]` will hit a string and raise a `TypeError`. — Deployment tooling that reads this generated catalog fails or misreads entries, and the next real regeneration will silently drop the hand-added key.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Not reviewed
- This review did not read lines 2234–8984 of `../pr.diff` (the middle of the `aaa-generated/catalog.json` hunk) line by line; instead it confirmed by pattern counts that the added lines are 1,500 `production-service-NNNN` keys, 1,500 `2xxxx` ports, the `},` line and the `review_note` line.
- No consumers of `aaa-generated/catalog.json` exist in this repository, so the downstream deployment tooling that reads it was not available for review.
